claims.claim_text: The indexed Sergeant Donald E. McInnis has a high-confidence match to an official Army enlistment entry.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The full name and a nonshared protected identifier agree after normalization of fixed-width MC INNIS surname spacing.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence from exact normalized full-name agreement and a unique protected-identifier match.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army entry establishes wartime identity context but not an immediate pre-OSS assignment or civilian employer.
claims.match_notes: Identity crosswalk only. Differing grade snapshots and the Army occupation code are not converted into employment evidence.

claims.claim_text: The protected identifier printed for indexed Private Loughlin G. McHugh points to an official Army entry whose middle initial is F rather than G.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The protected identifier and uncommon base name agree, but the middle initials conflict; the number is withheld from public output.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Conflicting: the unique identifier is strong evidence, but the explicit G/F middle-initial disagreement requires personnel-file review.
claims.temporal_assessment: The conflict concerns identity resolution only and supplies no reliable pre-OSS employer or affiliation chronology.
claims.match_notes: Review Box 507 before relying on the Army crosswalk. Army grade and occupation codes are not used as employer evidence.
